output.explanation: NIG-SA booked AED 54,150.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018978) against NIG-AE's invoice AE-ICINV-00483 for AED 57,000.00 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031305), a ratio of 0.95 consistent with 5% Saudi WHT on services, and the buyer description explicitly states 'net of WHT 5%'. The AED 2,850.00 gap (USD 776.03 at invoice-date rate) is withholding tax deducted for remittance to ZATCA, not a disagreement on the charge.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to AED 57,000 by recognising the AED 2,850 WHT liability to ZATCA and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-AE so it can record the tax receivable/credit.
output.adjustment_description: NIG-SA: reclassify AED 2,850 withheld so the IC payable to NIG-AE reflects the gross AED 57,000, with a separate WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority; NIG-AE: upon receipt of the WHT certificate, settle AED 2,850 of the IC receivable against a WHT recoverable/tax expense account.
